title: Raid on Bone
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Raid on Bone", at revision 1366208626, opens: "The Raid on Bone was a hit and run operation by the Knights of Saint Stephen and Tuscan troops against the Algerian town of Bône in 1607." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q7283724, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1607 raid". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
